title: Opportunity Gain vs Disruption Cost Model
description: Evaluates whether changing visual state provides sufficient narrative gain to justify the cognitive cost of interruption.
core_rule: Asset existence != reason to cut. A visual switch must provide clear qualitative gain over preserving current state continuity.
disruption_cost_factors: Breaking direct presenter eye contact during emotional or trust-critical speech.
Interrupting viewer spatial orientation during an active room appreciation.
Introducing rapid visual changes during complex spoken financial terms.
opportunity_gain_factors: Providing definitive visual proof of a major verbal claim (e.g. location convenience, balcony feature).
Resolving high visual debt when viewer curiosity peaks.
Clarifying complex figures with clean, minimal graphic cards.
